title: One Sentence. One Game.
script: I gave AI one sentence and asked for a playable game. Build an endless dodge game with keyboard controls, rising difficulty, a high score, and restart. This is the first playable attempt. I tested movement, collisions, restart, and whether the high score survived a refresh. [PLAYABILITY_RESULT]. [REAL_FIX_COUNT_AND_TIME]. Give me the next one-sentence game idea.
timingStatus: Estimated silent editorial timings. Refit scenes and caption timestamps to the unchanged voice-over when supplied.
concept: Endless dodge game with keyboard control, difficulty, score, high score and restart.
whyNow: AI coding and automation promises are judged by a reproducible useful task.
viewerGoal: Understand what the system actually completed and where supervision matters.
hooks: I gave AI one sentence and asked for a playable game.
One prompt. Can I actually play the result?
The game looks finished. Now press restart.
strongestHook: I gave AI one sentence and asked for a playable game.
directorBrief: Direct this as an observable challenge: Endless dodge game with keyboard control, difficulty, score, high score and restart. The viewer must see the starting problem, the exact constraint, one revealing action and the independently checked output. Let the real failure or correction create the turn. Save every first attempt. Completion claims alone never establish a result.
effort: 15–60 minutes core build/test; allow additional audit/edit time.
protocol: Prompt exactly: Build an endless dodge game with keyboard controls, rising difficulty, a high score, and restart. Use an isolated local browser project. Preserve first output. Verify left/right movement, collision loss, restart reset and high-score persistence across refresh. Record 30 seconds of actual play at normal speed, elapsed time and correction count. Failure can be the ending; do not author a fake working gameplay clip.
evidenceRequirements: Build and play it; count real fixes/time; don’t fabricate playability.
thumbnailDirection: Use the opening object or strongest real evidence crop. Put “One Sentence Game” in the top-middle safe area; one accent, no extra subheading.
ending: Give me the next one-sentence game idea.
instagramCaption: One Sentence. One Game.. Endless dodge game with keyboard control, difficulty, score, high score and restart. Full test conditions and limitations belong beside the final result. Give me the next one-sentence game idea.
tiktokCaption: One Sentence. One Game.. YOUR GAME IDEA?
music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
